reaudit_reason: CEO directive: Invention #3 was produced BEFORE the silent-promotion bug was caught. It has the same inflation pattern as V2: 75% model-derived evidence but Evidence gate scored 70/PASS.

PATENT_GATE.rationale: 102 based on model-derived summaries, not primary claims. 103 UNCERTAIN. Patent gate cannot PASS without primary claim analysis.

EVIDENCE_GATE.rationale: Only 2/8 evidence entries are primary-source (25%). 75% model-derived. Evidence gate cannot PASS with 25% primary.

TECHNICAL_GATE.rationale: All engineering is model-derived. No in-vitro validation.

SAFETY_GATE.rationale: Fail-safe is model-derived. No preclinical validation.

COMMERCIAL_GATE.rationale: Build/buy numbers are model-derived. IP moat unverified (103 UNCERTAIN).

state_machine.rule: if any hard/soft gate < threshold OR composite < 70: BUYER_READINESS = NOT_READY

final_status_rationale: Re-audited under corrected state machine. Composite dropped from 71 (inflated) to 45.0 (honest). All 5 gates FAIL. Evidence is 75% model-derived (was scored 70/PASS, should be 40/FAIL). Patent gate: 102 on model-derived summaries, not primary claims (was 72/PASS, should be 45/FAIL). BUYER_READINESS = NOT_READY. final_status = WOULD_NOT_PAY (per current V1 §16). Under PCP-001, this would be BELOW_BUYER_THRESHOLD if hard gates passed — but they don't.
